g.text: OC0B will go high when TCNT0 == 0x00 and go low when TCNT0 == OCR0B.

g.text: In this example, OCR0B == 24, which gives us a 20% duty cycle (25/125). We can use the interrupt on

g.text: OCR0A to change the value of OCR0B over time, varying the duty cycle and fading the LED in and out

g.text: With 1MHz clock, /8 Timer0 prescaler, ticks are 8us each.
